notes: The judge is not gpt-4o-2024-08-06, the judge the benchmark specifies (it answered as qwen3.8-27b). These scores are not comparable to published LongMemEval numbers.

11 of 999 answers stopped at the token limit (finish_reason length), and 11 had no text left for the judge, because the reader gave none or wrote only reasoning, which is removed before the judge sees an answer. An empty answer is scored wrong. A model that thinks before it answers can use its tokens on the thinking: use one that answers directly, or turn its thinking off.
